declaredLimits: Only the user-selected bounded read-only ordinary-reuse scope is reviewed; a fully unobserved eight-bit counter-wrap/address ABA is excluded.
Supported opaque-address equivalence and the actual cached RPH assembly identity must still be established by the separately authorized passive experiment.
Startup file verification, native calls and filesystem operations can block. Admission time budgets reject after return; no watchdog is claimed to forcibly interrupt every native/OS/fatal failure.
Arbitrary same-user or injected equal-privilege code is outside the claimed ownership boundary; no hostile in-process sandbox is claimed.
A fatal fault, forced termination, RPH fiber abort or OS failure may leave incomplete evidence/cleanup; unknown callback, audit or writer completion must stay unknown.

The proposed single-lease exit test proves exit-triggered retirement followed by absence/no resurrection; it does not independently prove silence caused that live retirement. Independent silence causation is offline fixture coverage.
The diagnostic producer acceptance is not inherited by the new producer, and no physical RPM, engine-off/restart, other model, NPC, playback, listening, loudness or recording acceptance is claimed.
